competing_explanation: The failure may be due to retrieval noise or indexing errors rather than a fundamental inability to identify controlling provisions, or the 'controlling' label itself may be ambiguous in the dataset.
hypothesis_statement: The baseline policy-RAG system fails to cite the controlling provision.
refutation_criterion: If the baseline system consistently cites the controlling provision in a majority of test cases, or if the failure rate is statistically indistinguishable from random chance or other non-controlling citations.
